one of the non-OspA, -B surface proteins of B. burgdoferi is regulated at the level of expression, and that the regulation occurs at the onset of the stationary phase in vitro.

the identification of the mechanisms that regulate the expression of Borrelial surface proteins.

the identification and characterization of surface proteins of Borreliaburgdorferi, the Lyme disease spirochete.
